data.title: 天雨亚子 · 迎宾露台的大胆露背晚礼服
data.description: 政务宴会退场后的夜风露台，月光如银倾泻在雕花石栏上。亚子身穿一袭惊艳的深黑丝绒露背晚礼服，白皙无瑕的整个美背在夜色中完全舒展。晚风拂起她灰色的卷发马尾，她单手扶着栏杆回眸望来，湛蓝眼眸在夜色中显得深沉而勾人心魄，展现出独当一面的高官冷艳与隐藏的炽热。

data.location: grand classical palace balcony under full moon
data.lighting: dramatic moonlit backlighting contrasting with warm stone sconces
data.promptProse: Standing on a grand classical marble balcony beneath the full moon, Amau Ako rests one hand on the stone balustrade in a midnight-blue backless evening gown with a high side slit and silver necklace. Turning over her bare shoulder with a composed, deep gaze as cool night wind stirs her hair, she is edged in silver moonlight and warm wall sconces.
data.animaCaption: Resting one hand along the marble palace balcony railing in a midnight-blue backless evening gown, she glances back over her bare shoulder as night wind lifts her hair. Silver full-moon backlighting contrasts with warm stone wall sconces.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a midnight-blue backless evening gown with a dramatic bare back, high side slit, and a slender silver necklace.
